profile.headline: Software Engineer ♢ Java ♢ Ruby ♢ Ruby on Rails ♢JavaScript ♢ React ♢ Redux ♢ Redux-Thunk
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer with experience in Customer Service and Tech Support. Through my experience, I gained valuable insight into the importance of user-oriented applications and products. With this in mind, I develop with user experience as a core principle. As a dedicated learner, I enjoy challenging problems to expand my knowledge.

Skills: JavaScript | React | Redux | Redux-Thunk | Ruby | Ruby on Rails | Sqlite3 | HTML5 | CSS | Git

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: As a Customer Service Rep, I was in charge of handling over 20 insurance claims at one time. During my employment, I was placed on the Worker's Compensation team that was sorting through a backlog of hundreds of cases due to the Coronavirus Pandemic. This backlog was effectively gone by February 2021. At this role, I was to schedule medical appointments for certain insurance claims and coordinate any communication between claimants, doctors, lawyers, and insurance agents.

positions.title: Tech Support Team
positions.description:
As an assistant to the Tech Team, my duties were centered on maintenance and optimization of technology distributed through out the department. I regularly patched software and operating systems in all labs, classrooms, and faculty offices in order to eliminate security risks and protect user data. I kept extensive records of machines deployed which included software and hardware. I helped set up the labs to be remotely controlled through a program called Deep Freeze, allowing for mass updates to be deployed immediately or at a specific time. 

My role was to also serve as an on call technical support. As faculty and classrooms are equipped with newer technology, I helped ensure that faculty, students, and guests could have their technical problems fixed promptly. Common issues regarding software or hardware were organized into a Standard Operating Procedure guide that will allow future assistant workers to quickly remedy problems they have not encountered yet.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: My role as an assistant for the administrative team in the Communications department was diverse. I helped faculty with classroom preparations, budget reconciliations for staff and faculty, helped coordinate events, created an organizational system for department purchases, and helped set up department wide meetings.

company.name: Zeta Beta Tau - Alpha Mu Chapter

positions.title: Certified Crew Member
positions.description:
My role at McDonald's was focused on excellent customer service within a fast paced environment. On the service side, my roles was to ensure that orders were accurately taken, and then promptly given to the customer. This required proper balance between taking new orders, and checking orders before they were handed out to guests. When issues with orders were raised by guests, I attempted to remedy any issues that were within my scope first, then find a manager if needed.

When working it the kitchen, it was important that orders were quickly made. Working in the kitchen required clear communication within the team. On the assembly side, it was important to communicate to the grill team what needed to be cooked immediately, or to ask how long until something would be ready. Communication to the grill manager included requests for assistance if there was a high volume of orders coming in and to restock any supplies that were in immediate need.
